challenges.title: Собственный HTTP-сервер
challenges.description: TCP, HTTP-запросы, файлы, сжатие и постоянные соединения.

extensions.name: HTTP Compression
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add [compression][http-compression] support to your HTTP server implementation.

Along the way you'll learn about compression, compression scheme negotiation and more.

[http-compression]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTTP_compression

extensions.name: Persistent Connections
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add [persistent connections][http-persistent-connections] support to your HTTP server implementation.

Along the way you'll learn about persistent connections, the `Connection` header and more.

[http-persistent-connections]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HTTP_persistent_connection

challenges.title: Собственный Redis
challenges.description: Команды Redis, структуры данных, хранение и репликация.

stages.name: The INFO command on a replica

extensions.name: Lists
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for [Lists][redis-lists] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn commands like [RPUSH][rpush-command], [LRANGE][lrange-command], and more.

[redis-lists]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/lists/
[rpush-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/rpush/
[lrange-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/lrange/

extensions.name: Streams
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for the [Stream][redis-streams-data-type] data type to your Redis implementation.

Along the way you'll learn about commands like [XADD][xadd-command], [XRANGE][xrange-command] and more.

[redis-streams-data-type]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/
[xadd-command]: https://redis.io/commands/xadd/
[xrange-command]: https://redis.io/commands/xrange/

extensions.name: Transactions
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for [Transactions][redis-transactions] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn about the [MULTI][multi-command], [EXEC][exec-command], and [DISCARD][discard-command] commands, as well as how Redis handles transactions atomically.

[redis-transactions]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/interact/transactions/
[multi-command]: https://redis.io/commands/multi/
[exec-command]: https://redis.io/commands/exec/
[discard-command]: https://redis.io/commands/discard/

extensions.name: Optimistic Locking
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for [Optimistic Locking][redis-optimistic-locking] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way you'll learn about the [WATCH][watch-command] command and how it works in synergy with the `MULTI`, `EXEC`, and `DISCARD` commands to achieve optimistic locking.

[redis-optimistic-locking]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/#cas
[watch-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/watch/

extensions.name: Replication
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for [Replication][redis-replication] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way you'll learn about how Redis's leader-follower replication works, the [PSYNC][redis-psync-command] command and more.

[redis-replication]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/oss_and_stack/management/replication/
[redis-psync-command]: https://redis.io/commands/psync/

extensions.name: RDB Persistence
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add [persistence][redis-persistence] support to your Redis implementation.

Along the way you'll learn about Redis's [RDB file format][rdb-file-format] and more.

[redis-persistence]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/oss_and_stack/management/persistence/
[rdb-file-format]: https://github.com/sripathikrishnan/redis-rdb-tools/blob/548b11ec3c81a603f5b321228d07a61a0b940159/docs/RDB_File_Format.textile

extensions.name: AOF Persistence
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add [AOF persistence][aof-persistence] support to your Redis implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn about Redis' AOF file format, and how Redis restores its database after crash.

[aof-persistence]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/oss_and_stack/management/persistence/#aof-advantages

extensions.name: Pub/Sub
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for [Publish/Subscribe (Pub/Sub)][redis-pub-sub] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn commands like [SUBSCRIBE][subscribe-command], [PUBLISH][publish-command], and more.

[redis-pub-sub]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/pubsub/
[subscribe-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/subscribe/
[publish-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/publish/

extensions.name: Sorted Sets
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for [Sorted Sets (zsets)][redis-zset] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn commands like [ZADD][zadd-command], [ZRANGE][zrange-command], and more.

[redis-zset]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/sorted-sets/
[zadd-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/zadd/
[zrange-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/zrange/

extensions.name: Bitmaps
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for [Bitmaps][redis-bitmap] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn commands like [SETBIT][setbit-command], [GETBIT][getbit-command], [BITCOUNT][bitcount-command], and more.

[redis-bitmap]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/bitmaps/
[setbit-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/setbit/
[getbit-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/getbit/
[bitcount-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/bitcount/

extensions.name: Geospatial Commands
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for [Geospatial Commands][geospatial-commands] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn commands like [GEOADD][geoadd-command], [GEOSEARCH][geosearch-command], and more.

[geospatial-commands]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/geospatial/
[geoadd-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/geoadd/
[geosearch-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/geosearch/

extensions.name: Authentication
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for default user [Authentication][redis-authentication] to your Redis implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn about commands like [ACL WHOAMI][acl-whoami-command], [ACL GETUSER][acl-getuser-command], [ACL SETUSER][acl-setuser-command], and [AUTH][auth-command], and more.

[redis-authentication]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/oss_and_stack/management/security/
[acl-whoami-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/acl-whoami/
[acl-getuser-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/acl-getuser/
[acl-setuser-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/acl-setuser/
[auth-command]: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/auth/

challenges.title: Собственный Shell
challenges.description: Командная оболочка: процессы, перенаправление, конвейеры и история.

extensions.name: Navigation
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add directory navigation support by implementing the `cd` and `pwd` commands.

Along the way, you'll learn about what the "current working directory" is, how to change it and more.

extensions.name: Quoting
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add quoting support to your shell.

Quoting allows you to preserve whitespace and special characters in your shell commands.

extensions.name: Redirection
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add redirection support to your shell.

Redirection allows you to redirect the output of a command to a file or another command.

extensions.name: Command Completion
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add command completion support to your shell.

Command completion allows you to autocomplete commands and executable files.

extensions.name: Filename Completion
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add path completion support to your shell.

Path completion allows you to autocomplete file and directory names.

extensions.name: Programmable Completion
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for the `complete` builtin and external completer scripts (`-C`).

Programmable completion lets you register custom tab-completion behavior for specific commands.

extensions.name: Background Jobs
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for launching and managing background jobs.

Background jobs allows you to run multiple commands in the background at once.

extensions.name: Pipelines
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for pipelines to your shell.

Pipelines allow you to connect multiple commands together, so the output of one command becomes the input of the next command.

extensions.name: History
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for viewing and recalling previously entered commands using the `history` builtin.

History allows you to view and recall previously entered commands. Also, use it to re-run previous commands using the UP and DOWN arrow keys.

extensions.name: History Persistence
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for persisting history to a file.

History persistence allows you to save and load previously entered commands to and from a file.

extensions.name: Parameter Expansion
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for shell variables and parameter expansion.

Shell variables allow you to store values and reference them in commands using `$VAR` or `${VAR}`.

challenges.title: Собственный Git
challenges.description: Объекты Git, коммиты, деревья и клонирование репозитория.

challenges.title: Собственный SQLite
challenges.description: Чтение формата SQLite, SQL-запросы и индексы.

stages.name: Read data from a single column
Filter data with a WHERE clause
Retrieve data using a full-table scan

challenges.title: Собственный DNS-сервер
challenges.description: DNS-пакеты, записи, ответы и пересылка запросов.

challenges.title: Собственный BitTorrent
challenges.description: Торрент-файлы, пиры, загрузка данных и magnet-ссылки.

extensions.name: Magnet Links
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers magnet links. Magnet links allow downloading files without the need of downloading a .torrent file first.

Along the way, you'll learn about the [magnet URI format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Magnet_URI_scheme), the [extension protocol](https://www.bittorrent.org/beps/bep_0010.html) and the [metadata extension](https://www.bittorrent.org/beps/bep_0009.html).

challenges.title: Собственная Kafka
challenges.description: Бинарный протокол Kafka, разделы, чтение и запись сообщений.

stages.name: Respond for invalid topic or partition
Respond for valid topic and partition
Produce to multiple partitions of multiple topics

extensions.name: Concurrent Clients
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for serving multiple clients simultaneously.

Along the way you'll learn about TCP connections, how to handle concurrency and more.

extensions.name: Listing Partitions
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for listing topic partitions by implementing the [DescribeTopicPartitions][describe-topic-partitions] API.

Along the way you'll learn about how Kafka stores messages on disk, the `__cluster_metadata` topic and more.

[describe-topic-partitions]: https://kafka.apache.org/42/design/protocol/#The_Messages_DescribeTopicPartitions

extensions.name: Consuming Messages
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for consuming messages by implementing the [Fetch][fetch-api] API.

Along the way you'll learn about how Kafka's Fetch API works, how Kafka stores messages on disk and more.

[fetch-api]: https://kafka.apache.org/42/design/protocol/#The_Messages_Fetch

extensions.name: Producing Messages
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension you'll add support for producing messages by implementing the [Produce][produce-api] API.

Along the way you'll learn about how Kafka's Produce API works, how Kafka stores messages on disk and more.

[produce-api]: https://kafka.apache.org/42/design/protocol/#The_Messages_Produce

challenges.title: Собственный Grep
challenges.description: Регулярные выражения, поиск в файлах и группы захвата.

stages.name: Match between n and m times

extensions.name: Printing Matches
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for printing matching lines to your Grep implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn about extracting matched lines, formatting output, and managing line-by-line processing.

extensions.name: Multiple Matches
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for printing the multiple matching results to your Grep implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn about how to implement the `-o` flag.

extensions.name: Highlighting
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for [highlighting][1] to your Grep implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn about [ANSI escape codes][2], and more.

[1]: https://linuxcommando.blogspot.com/2007/10/grep-with-color-output.html
[2]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ANSI_escape_code

extensions.name: File Search
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for searching files.

Along the way, you'll learn about how to implement efficient file I/O, directory traversal and pattern matching on file contents.

extensions.name: Quantifiers
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for [quantifiers][1] to your Grep implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn about how to implement the `*` quantifier (zero or more), and bounded quantifiers.
[1]: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/quantifiers-in-regular-expressions

extensions.name: Backreferences
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for [backreferences][1] to your Grep implementation.

Along the way, you'll learn about how capture groups and backreferences work.
[1]: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/standard/base-types/backreference-constructs-in-regular-expressions#numbered-backreferences

challenges.title: Собственный интерпретатор
challenges.description: От токенов и выражений до функций, классов и наследования.

stages.name: Invalid Usages of the super Keyword

extensions.name: Parsing Expressions
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers chapters 5 & 6 of the book ([Representing Code](https://craftinginterpreters.com/representing-code.html) & [Parsing Expressions](https://craftinginterpreters.com/parsing-expressions.html)).

In this extension, you'll add the ability to parse expressions.

extensions.name: Evaluating Expressions
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers chapters 7 of the book ([Evaluating Expressions](https://craftinginterpreters.com/evaluating-expressions.html)).

In this extension, you'll add the ability to evaluate expressions.

extensions.name: Statements & State
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers chapters 8 of the book ([Statements & State](https://craftinginterpreters.com/statements-and-state.html)).

In this extension, you'll add the ability to add internal state to your interpreter & produce output.

extensions.name: Control Flow
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers chapters 9 of the book ([Control Flow](https://craftinginterpreters.com/control-flow.html)).

In this extension, you'll add the ability to handle control flow statements like `if/else`, `while` & `for`.

extensions.name: Functions
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers chapters 10 of the book ([Functions](https://craftinginterpreters.com/functions.html)).

In this extension, you'll add the ability to handle lox native functions & user-defined functions.

extensions.name: Resolving & Binding
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers chapters 11 of the book ([Resolving & Binding](https://craftinginterpreters.com/resolving-and-binding.html)).

In this extension, you'll add the ability to semantically analyze variable declarations and resolve variable bindings at compile time.

extensions.name: Classes
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers chapters 12 of the book ([Classes](https://craftinginterpreters.com/classes.html)).

In this extension, you'll add the ability to handle lox classes, instances, constructors and methods.

extensions.name: Inheritance
extensions.description_markdown:
This extension covers chapters 13 of the book ([Inheritance](https://craftinginterpreters.com/inheritance.html)).

In this extension, you'll add the ability to handle class inheritance, method overriding and the super keyword.

challenges.title: Собственный Claude Code
challenges.description: Цикл ИИ-агента, инструменты и навыки для работы с кодом.

stages.name: Run a script bundled with a skill
Let the model choose a skill
Run a skill in a subagent

extensions.name: Skills
extensions.description_markdown:
In this challenge extension, you'll add support for [Skills][agent-skills] to your Claude Code implementation.

A skill is a folder of instructions for one specific task. Your agent finds skills on disk and loads one only when it's needed.

Along the way you'll learn about [progressive disclosure][progressive-disclosure], frontmatter parsing, argument substitution, letting the model choose a skill on its own, and handing one to a subagent.

[agent-skills]: https://agentskills.io/home
[progressive-disclosure]: https://agentskills.io/specification#progressive-disclosure
